# KeenTools

> > KeenTools develops professional 3D tracking, face modeling, and texture projection plugins for Blender, Nuke, and After Effects, featuring AI-powered tools like FaceBuilder, FaceTracker, and GeoTracker.

KeenTools specializes in computer vision and machine learning solutions for VFX artists and 3D professionals. Their product suite includes geometry-based tracking, markerless face reconstruction with ARKit blendshapes, MetaHuman integration workflows, and a Cloud API for automated 3D head generation.

## Key Topics

- FaceBuilder - 3D face modeling from photos
- FaceTracker - Markerless face tracking
- GeoTracker - 3D object and camera tracking
- Blender addons and integrations
- Nuke plugins and nodes
- After Effects tracking tools
- ARKit FACS blendshapes
- MetaHuman workflow integration
- Focal length estimation
- Texture mapping and projection
- TextureBuilder for clean plates
- ReadRiggedGeo for skeletal animation
- PinTool for precise tracking
- Cloud API for 3D reconstruction
- VFX education and training

## Core Products & Integrations

- [FaceTracker for Blender](https://keentools.io/products/facetracker-for-blender): Professional markerless face tracking for Blender with ARKit blendshapes
- [FaceBuilder for Nuke](https://keentools.io/products/facebuilder-for-nuke): 3D face/head modeling from photos with focal length estimation in Nuke
- [GeoTracker for Blender](https://keentools.io/products/geotracker-for-blender): Geometry-based 3D object/camera tracking with video texturing in Blender
- [TextureBuilder for Nuke](https://keentools.io/products/texturebuilder): Nuke node for multi-frame texture projection and clean plate creation
- [KeenTools Cloud API](https://keentools.io/products/api): Cloud API for 3D head reconstruction with blendshapes & texture mapping
- [FaceBuilder x MetaHuman](https://keentools.io/integrations/fbb-mh): Photo-to-MetaHuman workflow with FaceBuilder and Mesh to MetaHuman
- [ReadRiggedGeo for Nuke](https://keentools.io/products/readriggedgeo): Nuke node for skeletal animation and rigged FBX/Collada model import

- [KeenTools 2023.2.0 (8 August 2023)](https://keentools.io/news/2023-2): GeoTracker for Blender beta launch with object/camera tracking

## Major Feature Updates

- [KeenTools 2023.1.0 (7 March 2023)](https://keentools.io/news/2023-1): GeoTracker for After Effects enhancements with head tracking & masks
